support_spans: Within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, she developed skin symptoms
After initial improvement and later disease recurrence, she received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later, which led to recurrence and worsening of symptoms
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles
contradict_spans: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis (note: performed after corticosteroid treatment)
